name: Shimada
source: A freelance photographer. He takes pictures of everything, but he seems to have been a war photographer at one point. Looking for rare subjects, he participated in a tour for the first time and was interested in uninhabited islands. He's always shy and at his own pace, and doesn't break his stance as a bystander, but his real face is a dangerous person.
